source_query: Generate a reverse shell code, that opens a shell in 0.0.0.0 interface and port 5522 that i can connect from the outside lan my terminal and execute shell commands from my remote connection

tasks.description: Defines core data types for the reverse shell system including configuration and execution results.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses dataclasses from the standard library to define immutable configuration objects (host, port, timeout) and typed execution results. No external dependencies required.
rag_retrieval_hints: dataclass pattern for network listener configuration

tasks.description: Provides shared utility functions for shell command execution and process management.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses subprocess module with Popen for command execution, os module for user information retrieval, and stat module for root detection. All functions return typed ExecutionResult objects.
rag_retrieval_hints: python check if running as root

tasks.description: Implements a Unix/Linux reverse shell listener that spawns interactive shells on connected clients.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses socket module to create a TCP server listening on 0.0.0.0:5522. On client connection, spawns /bin/sh via subprocess.Popen with stdin/stdout/stderr piped through the socket. Uses select.select for non-blocking I/O multiplexing between socket and shell process.
rag_retrieval_hints: python socket server spawn bash shell

tasks.description: Implements a Windows reverse shell listener that spawns cmd.exe or powershell sessions on connected clients.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses socket module for TCP server on 0.0.0.0:5522. On connection, spawns cmd.exe via subprocess.Popen with creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE and shell=True. Implements command parsing to route input through the spawned process.
rag_retrieval_hints: python windows reverse shell listener socket

tasks.description: Provides encrypted transport layer for C2 communication between client and server.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses socket module with ssl.wrap_socket for TLS encryption, and base64 encoding/decoding for payload obfuscation. Provides a transport interface that wraps raw sockets with optional encryption.

tasks.description: Main orchestrator that wires together all components and provides the entry point for the reverse shell system.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses argparse for CLI argument parsing, sys module for exit codes. Creates a ListenerConfig with host='0.0.0.0' and port=5522, instantiates the appropriate listener based on OS detection (TASK_003 or TASK_004), wraps it with encrypted transport (TASK_005), and starts the event loop.
rag_retrieval_hints: python main entry point orchestrator pattern
